commit.message:
L214R-09..11 fix: tau rows publish f/tau2/tau only when all three are finite positive (else NOT_COMPUTED invalid_input: non_finite, values blank), the temperature-convention check requires the recomputed sigma_grain and factor finite positive before comparing (else a non_finite reason, never None), and the stop-contract number check reuses tau_flux._num so unconvertible JSON integers take the existing rejection reasons (96/96); gate run line and pending code_fp e76dbe08 in the two registration drafts and the receipt selftest

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_019HKnbzGsY9U5Gyw4qGqqzA
